test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rajashree Shirke was given which of the following prestigious dance awards of 2013 for her excellence in Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Academy Award.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Diploma in** Kathak and Bharatanatyam** is offered by the **Lasya Centre of Dance Education and Research, **whose principal is **Rajashree.**
 
• She is a well-known** theorist and esteemed scholar.**
 
• One of her research projects is **"Madan Samhara,"** a study of the Avadhi language found in** Tulsidas' "Ramcharitra Manas."**
 
• Every year, Lasya holds a festival called **Yatra. **
 
• Rajashree Shirke has been given the **Sangeet Natak Academy awards of 2013 **for her excellence in Kathak.
 
• **Sangeet Natak Academy Award:**
 
 
• The** Sangeet Natak Akademi** bestows the Sangeet Natak Academy Award.
 
• It is the **highest honor** in India bestowed upon those who work in the **performing arts.**
 
• Prior to **2003**, the prize came with a **citation, a tamrapatra, an angavastram (a shawl), and Rs. 50,000.**
 
• The** monetary award **has grown to ₹**1,000,000 since 2009.**
 
• The distinctions are presented in the performing arts categories of** music, dance, theater, other traditional arts, puppetry, and contribution/scholarship.**​
 
 
 
• **​Sangeet Natak Akademi:**
 
 
• The **Government of India** established the Sangeet Natak Akademi as its **national performing arts academy.**
 
• The** Indian Ministry of Education **established it on** May 31, 1952**, and it started operating in **1953.**
 
• **Dr. P. V. Rajamannar** was chosen as the organization's **first chairman.**
 
• On **January 28, 1953, Dr. Rajendra Prasad **inaugurated it during a special event held in the Parliament Building.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri:**

 
 
• The Padma Shri is** India's fourth-highest civilian honor, **behind the Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, and Padma Bhushan.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman:**
 
 
• The Indian state of** Madhya Pradesh** annually bestows the Kalidas Samman, a prize **for the arts.**
 
 
 
• **National Film Award:**
 
 
• The most **prestigious film awards** show in India is the National Film Awards.
 
• It was started in **1954. **
 
 

b7:T
